title: BGSD
description: config.ini [BGSD] section (BGSDConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

alpha.description: Bias prefactor for the BGSD objective.

beta.description: Energy offset used in the BGSD bias term.

gradientfinitedifference.description: Finite-difference step used to estimate the BGSD gradient.

Hforceconvergence.description: Convergence threshold for the Hessian-like force component.

grad2energyconvergence.description: Convergence threshold for the squared-gradient energy criterion.

grad2forceconvergence.description: Convergence threshold for the squared-gradient force criterion.
